description_en: Tags can mark resources, allowing enterprises or individuals to categorize templates of the same type for easier search and resource aggregation. Calls this operation to attach tags to SMS templates
description_zh: 标签可以标记资源，允许企业或个人将同类型的模板进行资源归类，便于搜索和资源聚合。调用本接口对短信模板进行标签绑定
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi tag-resources --resource-type TEMPLATE --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --prod-code dysms --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-id SMS_23420000 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Default value: TEMPLATE
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Default value: cn-hangzhou. For more region IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419270.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，默认取值：cn-hangzhou。更多地域ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419270.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The product name. Default value: dysms
parameters.name: prod_code

parameters.help_en: The tags. You can add up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh: 标签。单次添加的标签数量不超过20
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The SMS template code. You can specify up to 20 template codes
parameters.help_zh: 短信模板Code。数量不能超过20条
parameters.name: resource_id
